coldEmailTemplates.subject: The Falcon Guardian kill switch for your dev agents (without waiting for 2027)
coldEmailTemplates.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

With CrowdStrike acquiring Fiddler ($400M) and Dreadnode ($95M) to build their AI agent kill switch, George Kurtz confirmed what security teams are seeing on the ground: prompt instructions in CLAUDE.md fail, and AI agents need runtime guardrails that live *outside* the model.

While Falcon Observe won't ship until fiscal 2027, enterprise dev teams are deploying coding and workflow agents into production today.

We built ThumbGate (open-source + enterprise tier) to solve this right now:
1. External AI Kill Switch: Halts destructive commands, runaway wallet spend, and credential leaks at the OS/MCP level before execution.
2. Deterministic Flight Recorder: Cryptographic JSONL black box recording every agent intent, tool call, and state diff.
3. Dreadnode-Grade Red-Teaming: Automated testing against OWASP LLM Top 10 built directly into your CI pipeline.

Are you open to a 10-minute demo on how you can enforce runtime agent guardrails across your engineering team today?

Best,
Igor Ganapolsky
Founder, ThumbGate
https://github.com/IgorGanapolsky/ThumbGate
